svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Line chart of 4 series, North, South, East and West, over 6 points, from 2019 to 2024; values range from 3.5 to 9.4.
